speaker: Order Operations
text: Every business day, order operations copies the order file into a spreadsheet by hand.

speaker: Order Operations
text: Each run covers 1,200 orders and takes about 45 minutes per run.

speaker: PM
text: What business impact does this handoff have?

speaker: Order Operations
text: The handoff delays same-day shipment release by 45 minutes.

speaker: Order Operations
text: The order operations team owns this handoff.
